readerEvidence.summary: Fresh GPT-6.1 Sol ultra single-pass native source reading; 22 full source pages, 40 native questions, 40 retained figure references, 40 unique actual crops personally opened. No separate model checker or independent review.
sourceGaps: Archive answer-marked Socrative export gives one green check per question and no worked explanations. Answers are attributed to the archive, not to an independently verified official examiner.
Original questions show 0/1 PUNT per question and 0/40 result; these are unattempted export states, not scoring failures. Each of 40 native questions is worth 1 point.
Quiz PDF embeds all 40 composite visual resources; all actual images are retained. No missing photographs or answer rationale invented.
The question text layer loses letters throughout; personally read original page images are the transcription authority. Source typos doens't and eldery are preserved.
Socrative export dates 14 augustus 2021 and 13 september 2021 are preserved as export metadata, not represented as exam dates.

Mechanical text-layer report retains51alerts:40schema-attribution false positives and11lossy-font literal-word findings. Exact hash-bound source-reader dispositions resolve those51against original page images; raw report was not rewritten and is not claimed clean.

problems.title: iGeo 2021 MMT F2 — Multimedia Test
problems.summary: 40 multiple-choice questions (A-D, 1 point each) with photo, map and graph identification across all geography fields.

relatedCatalogueRows.printedMeta: iGeo (International Geography Olympiad) 2021, MMT F2 (Multimedia Test), 13 September 2021, 40 questions / 40 points
relatedCatalogueRows.notes: This is an answer-key version: each question shows 0/1 PUNT (all answered incorrectly) and the correct option marked with a green check. Subject is geography, so no physics topic ids apply. 40 questions span 11 pages.

relatedCatalogueRows.subject: geography
relatedCatalogueRows.title: iGeo 2021 · Мултимедиен тест · Задачи

problems.title: In what country were these photographs taken?
problems.summary: Photo collage identification of the country (Bolivia, Ecuador, Paraguay, Peru).

problems.title: In which environments is honeycomb weathering most abundant?
problems.summary: Identify environments favoring honeycomb weathering from photo and options.

problems.title: This map depicts ships around Istanbul… which photo corresponds to which numbered ships?
problems.summary: Match ship photos to AIS map colors of Istanbul ships, 24 May 2021.

problems.title: Which of the following is found in all the products shown in the image?
problems.summary: Find common ingredient (corn, palm oil, petroleum, wheat) in pictured products.

problems.title: Two news items on extreme heat in North America and floods in Germany and Belgium. How are these two events directly related?
problems.summary: Link heat dome and European floods via direct atmospheric cause.

problems.title: Which body of water can geologically be considered as a foreland basin?
problems.summary: Identify foreland basin among Mediterranean, Red Sea, Persian Gulf, Gulf of Aden.

problems.title: To which part of this destination image model do travel influencers on Instagram best correspond?
problems.summary: Place Instagram influencers in a destination image model component.

problems.title: A doctor's occupation is included in which line in this version of the Clark-Fisher Model?
problems.summary: Identify sector curve containing doctors in Clark-Fisher model graph.

problems.title: Plot of migration flows between world's top 25 sending and receiving countries in 2005-2010…
problems.summary: Classify income level of top outward-migration contributors 2005-2010.

problems.title: Glacial-latte-art. Which type of glacier is shown in this 'Earth-cappuccino'?
problems.summary: Recognize glacier type depicted by latte art (cirque, piedmont, tidewater, valley).

problems.title: What type of submarine farming does this aerial photo show?
problems.summary: Identify aquaculture type in aerial photo (coral, oysters, salmon, seaweed).

problems.title: Does it rain? Does it pour?
problems.summary: Identify map color for category 'usually doesn't rain but when it does, it pours'.

problems.title: This cartoon stresses the importance of:
problems.summary: Interpret cartoon with chimneys and greenery 2021-2041.

problems.title: The figure shows the shares of a trend (2000-2050). Which trend is it?
problems.summary: Identify trend from stacked-area shares chart by region (Others, Western Europe, USA…).

problems.title: Vermeer painted The Astronomer and The Geographer… Which one is more likely The Geographer and why?
problems.summary: Distinguish Vermeer's Geographer from Astronomer using depicted instruments.

problems.title: These fences on the edge of the road are meant to protect:
problems.summary: Identify purpose of roadside fences from photos (blizzards, animals, pollution, fog).

problems.title: Name the phenomenon shown here and identify what happens next.
problems.summary: Identify two interacting lows: cyclogenesis or Fujiwhara effect and outcome.

problems.title: What determines the difference between area A and area B in this true color satellite image?
problems.summary: Explain satellite-image difference between areas (mass movements, fire, geology, groundwater).

problems.title: Which layer of this podzol soil will have the highest Loss-On-Ignition-value?
problems.summary: Choose podzol horizon with highest organic content via LOI.

problems.title: In both pictures the grass strip has been replaced by rocks. To what purpose are grass strips replaced by rocks in these cities?
problems.summary: Explain purpose of rocky strips replacing grass in cities.

problems.title: Which age group is indicated with the red line ('X') in this world population prediction graph?
problems.summary: Read age-group line in UN world population projection chart.

problems.title: The map shows migration patterns for different types of Leatherbacks (sea turtles)… Which statement about area A and B is true?
problems.summary: Determine breeding vs feeding areas of two leatherback turtle species in July.

problems.title: Which of these population graphs fits a country with a large influx of labor migration?
problems.summary: Pick population pyramid showing labor-migration influx.

problems.title: The figure shows simplified maps for transport geography of three regions. Which region is represented by which simplified map?
problems.summary: Match three transport-geography schematic maps to world regions.

problems.title: What concept applies best to these images?
problems.summary: Identify concept (bimodal transport, de-industrialisation, gentrification, urban blight) from path photos.

problems.title: What does this map illustrate?
problems.summary: Identify world map of critically/vulnerably/endangered items (health, languages, economies, religions).

problems.title: State the solar time at location D if the solar time at location C is 6:00 a.m.
problems.summary: Compute solar time difference between two longitudes on globe diagram.

problems.title: Based on data from Twitter, this map shows how Barcelona is perceived by:
problems.summary: Identify groups behind red/blue/yellow photo dots on Barcelona heat map.

problems.title: Once the natural resource phosphate got exhausted on Nauru… What is seen to be the second cause of the 'Dutch disease'?
problems.summary: Identify second cause of Dutch disease in Nauru's post-phosphate economy.

problems.title: Which location in this triangular graph fits a country in phase 5 of the Demographic Transition Model?
problems.summary: Locate phase-5 DTM country on young/proportion/elderly ternary plot.

problems.title: To which hazard do both resources relate?
problems.summary: Identify shared hazard (glacial melt, lahar, lava flow, pyroclastic flow) of two images.

problems.title: A geographer is doing research using colored water. What coastal phenomenon is this geographer doing research on?
problems.summary: Identify coastal phenomenon from aerial dye-release photo.

problems.title: Which image relates to the shaded area on the map?
problems.summary: Match photo to shaded zone on map (canal/desert region).

problems.title: The economy of which group of countries is impacted most (-4.7%) following this 'model of transmission channels of COVID-19 economic impact'?
problems.summary: Identify country group with -4.7% forecast GDP impact in COVID-19 model.

problems.title: Which city street orientation radial corresponds with Buenos Aires?
problems.summary: Match Buenos Aires street map to its orientation radial diagram.

problems.title: This pair of graphs shows which worldwide distribution?
problems.summary: Identify variable shown by paired coastline-mirror graphs (salinity, biomass, waterbodies, temperature).

problems.title: 'The Product Space' depicts worldwide connectedness between products… The exports of which country are marked with colored dots?
problems.summary: Identify country whose exports are highlighted in product space network.

problems.title: Which map is sized after worldwide refugee destinations in 2018?
problems.summary: Pick cartogram showing 2018 refugee destinations.

problems.title: To what type of renewable energy is this map related?
problems.summary: Identify renewable-energy type mapped over South America.

problems.title: Earthmap in a pond. Where is Istanbul located in this world map?
problems.summary: Locate Istanbul on a pond-shaped world earthwork map.
